icons.name: Highlights

icons.name: Tone curves

icons.name: Levels
icons.prompt: A histogram with black-point, midtone, and white-point sliders beneath it.

icons.name: Vibrance
icons.prompt: Muted and vivid color swatches paired with an adjustment slider, representing selective enhancement of less saturated colors.

icons.name: Color temperature
icons.prompt: A thermometer beside a blue-to-orange gradient, representing cool-to-warm color adjustment.

icons.name: Tint

icons.name: Sharpness
icons.prompt: A split image edge shown soft on one side and crisp on the other, representing sharpening adjustment.

icons.name: Noise reduction
icons.prompt: A dotted image patch transitioning into a smooth patch, representing reduction of image noise.

icons.name: Vignette
icons.prompt: A rectangular image frame with darkened corners and a bright center, representing edge-darkening adjustment.

icons.name: Resolution
icons.prompt: An image frame with horizontal and vertical pixel dimensions marked along its edges.

icons.name: Aspect ratio

icons.name: Image bit depth

icons.name: Color space

icons.name: Color profile

icons.name: Compression quality
icons.prompt: An image thumbnail paired with a quality slider and file-size indicator represents the balance between detail and compression.

icons.name: Image transparency
icons.prompt: A partially transparent image tile reveals a checkerboard background beneath it.

icons.name: ISO sensitivity
icons.prompt: A camera sensor paired with a sensitivity scale and grain dots represents ISO adjustment.

icons.name: Exposure compensation
icons.prompt: A camera paired with a centered negative-to-positive EV scale represents compensation relative to metered exposure.

icons.name: Metering mode
icons.prompt: Three viewfinder frames show full-frame, center-weighted, and spot metering patterns.

icons.name: Lens focal length
icons.prompt: A lens beside wide and narrow viewing-angle cones represents focal length selection.

icons.name: Autofocus mode
icons.prompt: A focus bracket paired with a still subject and a moving subject represents single and continuous autofocus.

icons.name: Focus area
icons.prompt: A viewfinder grid with one highlighted point and a larger highlighted zone represents focus-area selection.

icons.name: Image stabilization
icons.prompt: A camera surrounded by vibration marks and a steady central frame represents shake compensation.

icons.name: High dynamic range
icons.prompt: Three differently exposed photo frames combine into one image retaining bright and dark details.

icons.name: Exposure bracketing
icons.prompt: Three stacked camera frames marked with negative, neutral, and positive exposure indicators represent a bracketed capture sequence.

icons.name: RAW capture
icons.prompt: A camera sensor paired with an unprocessed image file represents recording raw sensor data.

icons.name: Hue
icons.prompt: A circular color wheel with a movable marker represents hue adjustment.

icons.name: HSL adjustment
icons.prompt: A selected color swatch sits beside three sliders for hue, saturation, and lightness.

icons.name: Channel mixer
icons.prompt: Red, green, and blue channel streams converge into a single output swatch.

icons.name: Color grading
icons.prompt: Three small color wheels represent separate color treatments for shadows, midtones, and highlights.

icons.name: Selective color adjustment
icons.prompt: One color group is isolated from a row of swatches and paired with adjustment sliders.

icons.name: Black-and-white conversion
icons.prompt: A split photo transitions from colored details to grayscale tones.

icons.name: LUT color mapping
icons.prompt: A color cube connects an original image thumbnail to a differently graded version.

icons.name: Selection tool
icons.prompt: A dashed boundary surrounds a selected region inside an image frame.

icons.name: Lasso selection
icons.prompt: An irregular dashed loop with a cursor represents a freehand selection boundary.

icons.name: Subject selection

icons.name: Image mask

icons.name: Mask feathering
icons.prompt: A selection edge transitions gradually from opaque to transparent, representing a softened mask boundary.

icons.name: Local adjustment

icons.name: Graduated filter

icons.name: Radial filter
icons.prompt: An elliptical overlay with a soft edge highlights a region for local tonal adjustment.

icons.prompt: A brush crosses a small blemish that blends into the surrounding image texture.

icons.name: Clone stamp
icons.prompt: A stamp links a source patch to a matching destination patch within an image.

icons.name: Content-aware fill
icons.prompt: A missing image region is filled with texture matching its surrounding area.

icons.name: Red-eye removal
icons.prompt: A pair of eyes shows a red pupil changing to a natural dark pupil.

icons.name: Skin retouching
icons.prompt: A facial detail patch shows reduced blemishes while retaining visible skin texture.

icons.name: Dodge and burn
icons.prompt: Two brush tips respectively lighten and darken small areas of the same image.

icons.name: Background removal
icons.prompt: An isolated subject remains in front of a checkerboard transparency background.

icons.name: Perspective correction
icons.prompt: A tilted trapezoidal building outline transforms into a rectangle with parallel vertical edges.

icons.name: Lens distortion correction
icons.prompt: A bowed grid transitions into a straight grid, representing correction of barrel or pincushion distortion.

icons.name: Chromatic aberration removal
icons.prompt: A magnified edge loses its red and blue fringes after correction.

icons.name: Dehaze
icons.prompt: A misty landscape thumbnail transitions into a clearer version with recovered contrast.

icons.name: Texture adjustment
icons.prompt: A magnified textured surface paired with a slider represents control of fine and medium-sized detail.

icons.name: Clarity adjustment
icons.prompt: A midtone detail patch gains stronger local contrast without changing the image dimensions.

icons.name: Film grain
icons.prompt: A photo patch with evenly distributed grain dots sits beside an intensity slider.

icons.name: Image layers
icons.prompt: Several separated image planes stack vertically to represent independently editable layers.

icons.name: Layer blend mode
icons.prompt: Overlapping colored tiles produce different intersection effects, representing layer blending operations.

icons.name: Photo metadata
icons.prompt: A photo thumbnail paired with an information panel containing camera, time, and location symbols represents EXIF metadata.

icons.name: Graph theory
icons.prompt: The study of mathematical graphs composed of vertices and edges, which can be represented by a few dots and connecting lines, distinct from statistical charts.

icons.name: AND gate
icons.prompt: A two-input AND gate symbol with a flat left edge and rounded right edge. The output is high only when both inputs are high.

icons.name: OR gate
icons.prompt: A two-input OR gate symbol with a concave input edge and pointed output end. The output is high when at least one input is high.

icons.name: NOT gate
icons.prompt: A triangular inverter symbol with one input and a small inversion bubble at the output. The output is the logical inverse of the input.

icons.name: NAND gate
icons.prompt: A two-input AND gate symbol with a small inversion bubble at the output. The output is low only when both inputs are high.

icons.name: NOR gate
icons.prompt: A two-input OR gate symbol with a small inversion bubble at the output. The output is high only when both inputs are low.

icons.name: XOR gate
icons.prompt: A two-input OR-shaped symbol with an additional curved line on the input side. The output is high when the two inputs differ.

icons.name: XNOR gate
icons.prompt: A two-input XOR gate symbol with a small inversion bubble at the output. The output is high when the two inputs are equal.

icons.name: Buffer gate
icons.prompt: A triangular symbol with one input and one output, without an inversion bubble. The output preserves the input logic state.

icons.name: Tri-state buffer
icons.prompt: A triangular buffer symbol with an additional active-high enable input entering from below. When disabled, the output enters a high-impedance state rather than outputting high or low.

icons.name: Transmission gate
icons.prompt: A bidirectional switch symbol with complementary control inputs, representing parallel NMOS and PMOS transistors. When enabled, it passes signals in either direction; when disabled, it presents a high-impedance state.

icons.name: Network port

icons.name: Message queue
